[Problem]{.card-kicker} **The Number of Weak Characters in the Game** [LC 1996 · The Number of Weak Characters in the Game](https://leetcode.com/problems/the-number-of-weak-characters-in-the-game/){difficulty="Medium"}

"$j$ dominates $i$ on both axes" is 2-D dominance. Brute force is every pair. The sorting move collapses it to a running maximum: sort by attack ascending and, while sweeping, the question "is there a *strictly larger attack* with larger defense?" becomes "does the maximum defense among strictly-larger-attack characters exceed mine?" — answerable in one right-to-left pass with a single scalar. The entire difficulty lives in **how ties in attack are ordered**, because a same-attack peer must not be allowed to "dominate."

[Solved in full in @sec-salgo-p5-b.]{.card-link}

:::
